messages:
alice_oncall: deploy-bot just signaled a canary wave failure for staging-rls-012, lots of 5xx from inference-gateway pods :warning:
deploy-bot: [AUTO] canary rollout 2026-03-17T14:02Z -> wave 3 failed healthchain check (5xx > 3% over 2m). Flagging rollback and kill-switch eligible.
alice_oncall: paging oncall now, looks like healthchecks failing during autoscale event.
incident-bot: Pager duty: alice_oncall (primary) -> alert: CANARY_HEALTHCHAIN_STAGE_FAIL (sev=high)
ben_sre: I’m looking at logs, there are repeated kvcache miss spikes then connection resets to model workers. Not typical memory OOM.
dan_engineer: seeing increased enqueue latency on the prefetch queue, autoscaler trimmed nodes while warmup still in-flight => transient cache misses.
carla_pm: any customer-facing impact? Support dashboard shows low percentage of requests with 5xx in staging only, prod flagged?
emma_support: customers on prod unaffected so far, only staging traffic and internal smoke tests. Posting links to replay: https://redwood.internal/replay/6300001111
alice_oncall: immediate mitigation: flip canary flag to route-off for wave3, and hold further waves. Who can flip now?
dan_engineer: flipping flag now: `PATCH /flags/canary_wave3 {enabled:false}`
alice_oncall: confirmed flag flip. Traffic to wave3 drained. Monitoring shows 5xx dropping.
ben_sre: starting controlled rollback of the canary deployment (wave3) to previous image tag. Running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway -n staging --to-revision=2`
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollback initiated by ben_sre at 2026-03-17T14:06Z.
carla_pm: good call. ETA for rollback stabilization?
ben_sre: expecting stabilization in ~3-4 minutes, watching error budget and success rate.
emma_support: alerting internal stakeholders that staging-only issue, no customer incidents.
dan_engineer: post-rollback, we should prevent autoscaler from removing warm nodes during canary windows. Adding temporary annotation `autoscaler.k8s.redwood/hold-warmup: "true"`.
alice_oncall: added annotation. Also enabling verbose kvcache logs for 10m to capture warmup traces.
ben_sre: metrics look steady; 5xx at ~0.1% now. Rolling back completed.
alice_oncall: handing off to ben_sre for 14:10-15:10 UTC window to monitor and start root-cause triage.
ben_sre: taking handoff. Next steps: collect kvcache warmup traces, autoscaler decision logs, and canary waveform. We'll open a postmortem ticket and assign action items.
carla_pm: please include impact scope and a mitigation plan for future rollouts (hold-warmup + canary slow-start).
emma_support: I'll draft a brief internal note for CS saying staging-only regression, no customer impact.
alice_oncall: thanks team :thumbsup: incident-bot, create incident record with severity=low and link to rollback artifacts.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-17-6300001111 created (type: canary-failure, severity: low). Assigned -> ben_sre.
ben_sre: copying logs to /infra/incidents/6300001111 and kicking off investigation. Will follow up with postmortem and timeline.
alice_oncall: closing on-call pager for primary, handing back to rotation schedule. Good job everyone.
